<enum>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<description>
Used by <page>game.AddAmmoType</page>'s input structure - the <page>Structures/AmmoData</page>.

<warning>These enumerations do not exist in game and are listed here only for reference</warning>
	</description>
	<items>
<item key="AMMO_FORCE_DROP_IF_CARRIED" value="1">Forces player to drop the object they are carrying if the object was hit by this ammo type.</item>
<item key="AMMO_INTERPRET_PLRDAMAGE_AS_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER" value="2">Uses <page text="AmmoData">Structures/AmmoData</page>.plydmg of the ammo type as the damage to deal to shot players instead of <page text="Bullet">Structures/Bullet</page>.Damage.</item>
	</items>

</enum>
